verses.text: Ix ek'nhej tiempo, ix ichamwinakax winhaj Isaac chi', maxtzak ujilaj yilan winh. Ay jun k'uhal ix yawtejkot winhaj Esaú winh, haton winh sb'ab'el yuninal winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ach wuninal, xchi winh. --¿Tas xchi mamin? xchi winhaj Esaú chi'.
--Tik wal tzila' te icham winak inxo. Manh wojtakok, k'inalok sja lemnaj in chamel k'ik'an chab'ej.
Yuj chi' tzin nib'ej tzach b'at a say junok nok' t'a kaltak te' yik tzik'kot in chi'a. Ik'b'at a jul-lab' yik tza jul junok wiko'.
Tza b'oan junok in wa'el te wach', icha wal in gana. Ayik toxo ix b'oi, tzik'ankot t'ayin. Yakb'an tzin wa'i, ol walankan wach' lolonel t'a ib'anh yakb'an manto in chamok, xchi winh.
Haxo ix Rebeca, ix yab' ix tas ix yal winh t'a winhaj Esaú chi', yuj chi' ayik toxo ix b'at winhaj Esaú chi' t'a kaltak te' say schib'ej smam chi',
ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Jacob, winh schab'il yune' ix: --Ha tiknaik ach wune', ix wab' wal yalan winh a mam t'a winh uk'tak aj Esaú icha tik:

Ixik say junok k'ultakil nok' in chi'a, tza b'oan junok in wa'el, te wach' tzutej. Yakb'an tzin wa'i ol wak'ankan yaxilal t'ayach, ol walankan wach' lolonel t'a ib'anh t'a yichanh Jehová yakb'an manto in chamok, xchi winh a mam chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ach wune', k'anab'ajej wal tas ol wal tik.
Ixik b'aj ay nok' kalnel, tzik'ankot chawanhok nok' yunetak chiwa te wach', ol in b'oan junok swa'el winh a mam chi', te wach' ol wutej icha wal tas snib'ej winh.
Ha hachxo ol ik'b'at t'a winh. Ayik wan swa winh, ol yalankan wach' lolonel winh t'a ib'anh yakb'an manto cham winh, xchi ix.
Ix yalan winhaj Jacob t'a ix snun chi': --Ha winh wuk'tak chi', ay xil sniwanil winh, palta a in tik malaj in xi'il.
K'inalok ol in smaslej winh in mam chi', ol nachajel yuj winh, ol sna'an winh to tonhej swixtej winh, haxo katab' ol kotkan t'a wib'anh, manhxo'ok yaxilal ol wik'kani, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix snun winh chi' icha tik: --Ma'ay ach wune', tato ay katab' syalkan winh, aokab' t'a wib'anh skotkani. Ha tiknaik, anhej to tza k'anab'ajej tas swala'. Ixik, ik'kot chawanhok nok' yunetak chiwa chi', xchi ix.
Ix b'at winhaj Jacob chi' yik'kot nok' yunetak chiwa chi', ix yak'an nok' winh t'a ix snun chi'. Wach' ix aj jun wa'el chi' yuj ix, icha wal snib'ej winhaj Isaac chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anelta spichul winhaj Esaú chi' ix, winh sb'ab'el yune' ix, juntzanh pichul te wach', sik'b'ilb'at b'aj ay smantiado, ix yak'anoch ix t'a winhaj Jacob winh schab'il unin chi'.
Haxo t'a stz'umal nok' chiwa chi' ix spich sk'ab' winh ix yet' sjaj winh b'aj malaj xi'il.
Ix yak'an ixim pan ix yet' wa'el ix sb'o chi', ix yik'anb'at winh.
Haxo ix ochb'at winh b'aj ayek' winh smam chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamin, xchi winh. --Oy, ¿mach ach ach wuninal? xchi winhaj Isaac chi'.

--Ha in Esaú in, a b'ab'el unin in. Toxo ix in b'o a wa'el icha ix al t'ayin. K'e'anh k'ojan, wa''anh. Ab'lej wal jab'ok nok' k'ultakil nok' ix b'at in jul tik, tzalankan wach' lolonel t'a wib'anh, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Isaac chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas wal ix utej yamchaj nok' t'a elanhchamel, ach wuninal? xchi winh. --Ha Jehová ko Diosal ix och wet'ok, yuj chi' t'a elanhchamel ix ilchaj nok' wu'uj, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax winhaj Isaac chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Nitzkot a b'a t'a in tz'ey, ol ach in maslej, ta yel a ach ach wuninal Esaú, xchi winh.

Ix snitzanoch sb'a winh t'a stz'ey winh smam chi', ix och ijan winh smaslan winh tato ay xi'il winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh smam winh chi' icha tik: Icha wal yoch sjaj winhaj Jacob swab'i, anhej jun to ay xil a k'ab' swab'i icha wal yik winhaj Esaú, xchi winh.
Maj nachajel-laj yuj winh smam winh chi', yujto ay xi'il sk'ab' winh icha wal yik winhaj Esaú chi', yuj chi' ix yalankan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh winh.
Ix sk'anb'anxi winhaj Isaac chi' icha tik: --¿Yel am wal a ach, ach wuninal Esaú? xchi winh. --I', a in ton Esaú in, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.

--Ach wuninal, ik'kot in wa'el chi' an, yakb'an tzin chi nok' k'ultakil nok' xit' ik'kot chi', ol walankan wach' lolonel t'a ib'anh, xchi winh. Ix yak'an winhaj Jacob swa'el winh smam chi', ix yik'anpaxkot wino winh, ix yuk'an winh smam winh chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' icha tik: --Nitzkot a b'a t'a in tz'ey ach wuninal, tza tz'ub'anelta in ti', xchi winh.

Ix snitzanb'at sb'a winhaj Jacob chi', ix tz'ub'anelta sti' winh smam winh chi'. Ix suk'lan spichul winh winhaj Isaac chi', ix yalan wach' lolonel chi' winh t'a yib'anh winh icha tik: Icha sjab' anh ank'ultak ay t'a kaltak te' tz'ak'ji syaxil yuj Jehová, icha wal chi' sjab' winh wuninal.
Ak'jokab' nhab' t'a yib'anh lum a lu'um yuj Dios yik te wach' ol aj sat awb'en. Manhxo jantakok ixim trigo yet' wino ol ik'a'.

Tzijtum anima ol ach ak'an serwil. Masanil nación ol yak'em sb'a t'ayach. Yajal ol ach aj t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winh uk'tak. Ol yak'em sb'a heb' t'ayach. Ol kan skatab' Dios t'a yib'anh heb' chuk syutej sb'a t'ayach, palta ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' wach' syutej sb'a t'ayach, xchi winh.
Haxo yik ix lajwi yalankan masanil wach' lolonel chi' winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Jacob chi', hato wal yelta winh chi' b'aj ayek' winh smam chi', ix jax winhaj Esaú chi' juloj nok' chi'.

Ix sb'o'an jun wa'el winh te wach'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anpaxb'at winh t'a winh smam chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --K'e'anh wa'an mamin, tik in jawi. Chi' nok' k'ultakil nok' ix b'at wik'kot tik, tzalankan wach' lolonel chi' t'a wib'anh, xchi winh t'a winh smam chi'.
Haxo ix sk'anb'an winhaj Isaac chi' icha tik: --¿Mach ach? xchi winh. --Ha in ton Esaú in, a b'ab'el unin in, xchi winh.

Ix te sat sk'ol winhaj Isaac chi', ix och ijan winh slukloni, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Mach pax jun winh ix b'at ik'ankot nok' t'a sb'ab'elal jun, ix yik'ankot jun wa'el chi' t'ayin? Toxo ix in wa'i, ayik manto ach ja ach tik, yuj chi' toxo ix walkan in wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh winh chi'. Toxonton a winh ol cha'an in wach'k'olal chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Esaú tas ix yal winh smam chi', ix el wek'ek'ok yaw winh yok'i, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Alpax wach' lolonel t'a wib'anh mamin, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' icha tik: --Ha winh uk'tak ix ul in ixtanok, toxo ix yik'b'at masanil wach' lolonel winh iktaxon yaji, xchi winh. Haxo ix tak'wi winhaj Esaú chi':

Te wach' wal ochnakkan Jacob t'a winh. Schaelalxo in yixtan winh tik. T'a sb'ab'elal ix yik'ek' in derecho winh t'a yik in b'ab'el uninal, haxo pax tiknaik syik'anpaxek' yaxilal winh to wiktaxon yaj u'uj. Mamin, ¿manhxom wal junokxo yaxil ix a k'ub'ejkan t'ayin? xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' t'a winh: --Ina ix wak' yopisio winhaj Jacob t'a ib'anh, masanil heb' inhtilal ol ochkan schekab'ok winh. Hanheja' toxo ix walkani to te wach' ol yak' ixim strigo winh yet' swino. Manhxalaj tas wach' ach wutan ach wuninal, xchi winh.
Ix tewinhejoch winhaj Esaú chi' icha tik: --Mamin, ¿manhxom wal junok wach' lolonel syal alankan t'a wib'anh jun? Alkan junokxo a wach' lolonel t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix helxi wek'ek'ok yaw winh yok'i.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Isaac chi' t'a winh icha tik: Te najat tzach elkan t'a sat lum lum yax sat yet' b'aj syak' nhab'.
Anhej k'e'en espada ol ak'och yipok a k'o'ol, chekab' ol ach ajkan t'a winh uk'tak chi'. Haxo yik ayxo ip jun, ol a kol a b'a t'a winh, xchi winh.

Atax ta' ix chichonkanoch sk'o'ol winhaj Esaú t'a winhaj Jacob chi' yuj tas ix alchajkan t'a yib'anh winh yuj smam chi'. Yuj chi' ix sna'an winhaj Esaú chi' icha tik: Toxo ol cham winh in mam tik, ol lajwok chi' ol in milancham jun wuk'tak chi', xchi winh.

Haxo yik ix yab'an ix Rebeca tas wan yalan winhaj Esaú chi', ix yawtankot winhaj Jacob chi' ix, ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ach wune', a winhaj Esaú winh uk'tak, snib'ej winh ol ach smilchamok yik syak'ek' spak winh t'ayach.
Yuj wal chi', ab' wal tas swala': Elanh t'a tik, tzach b'atkan t'a Harán, tzach aj yet' winhaj Labán winh in nulej.
Tzach kannhej yet' winh junok tiempoal masanto tzek' yowal sk'o'ol winh uk'tak tik.
Haxo yik ol sat t'a sk'ol winh, ol walanb'at ab'i, ichato chi' ol ach paxta. Max yal in k'o'ol to junnhej k'uhal tzex cham he chawanhil, xchi ix.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan ix Rebeca t'a winhaj Isaac icha tik: --Tzin te kus yuj heb' ix hitita, heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj Esaú tik. Yuj chi' tato syik'laj sb'a winhaj Jacob tik yet' junok heb' ix hitita kajan t'a Canaán tik, wach' hama tato tzin chami, xchi ix.
